tagline: Innovation powers the global technology ecosystem anchored in the cloud, and extending from consumer devices to the edge enabling the data-driven future, including AI and emerging applications.
hero_kpi_rationale: The Cloud segment is the primary growth driver for WDC, capitalizing on the exponential increase in data creation, particularly for AI, where HDDs remain the most cost-effective solution for mass storage.

kpis.name: Cloud Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of storage products for public or private cloud environments and enterprise customers.
kpis.description: This segment includes products designed for cloud data centers, enterprise storage systems, and edge computing.
kpis.signal: The Cloud segment is the primary growth driver for WDC, capitalizing on the exponential increase in data creation, particularly for AI.

kpis.name: Client Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from storage products for OEM clients and distribution channels, including high-performance hard drives for desktop and notebook computers.
kpis.description: This segment serves original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and channel customers, offering HDD solutions for desktop and notebook computers.
kpis.signal: Provides high-performance HDD solutions for computer manufacturers and distribution channels.

kpis.name: Consumer Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from the sale of storage products directly to end consumers, leveraging brand recognition and an extensive distribution network.
kpis.description: This segment includes a broad range of retail products and other products for end users, leveraging brand recognition and points of presence.
kpis.signal: Capitalizes on brand strength and global presence for consumer storage products.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Represents the direct profitability of manufacturing and product sales activities.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of product profitability and production efficiency.

kpis.name: R&D Spending (% revenue)
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue allocated to research and development activities for product innovation.
kpis.description: Measures investment in developing new technologies and products to maintain competitive advantage.
kpis.signal: Indicates the company's commitment to technological innovation in the storage sector.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total net revenue generated from the sale of data storage products and services.
kpis.description: Represents the total consolidated net revenue for Western Digital for fiscal year 2025.
kpis.signal: Primary indicator of business performance and company growth.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 14.0 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 4.71 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 7 fiscal years reported in 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Revenue of 9.52 Bn $ in the latest year.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Consolidated annual net income, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 fiscal years reported in 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Net income of 1.889 Bn $ in the latest year.

risks.title: Geopolitical risks and economic conditions
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical tensions, changes in trade policy (tariffs), conflicts, and adverse macroeconomic conditions can significantly disrupt the company's supply chains and operations, which depend heavily on international markets.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: Cybersecurity incidents can have a significant impact on the company's operations, particularly due to dependence on information systems and sensitive data.

risks.title: Operational risks
risks.score_rationale: Operational issues, such as factory downtime or supply chain disruptions, can have a significant impact on the company's operations.

risks.title: Supplier dependence
risks.score_rationale: Dependence on key suppliers can create risks for the company, particularly in case of supply chain disruptions.

risks.title: Personnel risks
risks.score_rationale: Loss of key personnel or inability to attract and retain talent can have a significant impact on the company's operations.

risks.title: Regulatory risks
risks.score_rationale: Regulatory changes or non-compliance can have a significant impact on the company's operations.

risks.title: Reputation risks
risks.score_rationale: Reputation incidents, such as scandals or quality issues, can have a significant impact on the company's operations.

ai_positioning.summary: Western Digital cites artificial intelligence as an important driver of market growth, particularly for mass storage needs in cloud and hyperscale data centers. The company positions HDDs as the most cost-effective solution for storing large volumes of data in the AI era.
evidence: As global data creation continues to accelerate, particularly in the age of AI, and as the need to store and retain data also grows, we believe HDDs will continue to remain the preferred technology for storing large volumes of data as the most economical solution to the large cloud data centers for their mass storage needs.
in the age of AI, we believe HDDs will continue to remain the preferred technology
